DIGITAL PRODUCT FACTORY - START HERE
====================================

There is no installer. It is one program. Here is the whole setup.


1. FIRST TIME - THREE STEPS
---------------------------

   1. Download the zip.
   2. Right-click it and choose "Extract All".
   3. Open the extracted folder and double-click  dpf.exe

That is it. It runs.

WHERE TO PUT IT: anywhere you like. A folder in your Documents, a folder on
your desktop, a Windows VPS - all fine. You do NOT have to move it into any
particular place, and you do NOT have to run it from Program Files.

Just keep the whole folder together (dpf.exe plus the files beside it),
because the two .bat files and the guide live in there with it.

KEEP ONE COPY. If you extract a newer version somewhere else later, you will
have two folders. Both work, they share the same data, but it is tidier to
keep one. See "HOW TO UPDATE" below.


2. WHERE YOUR WORK IS SAVED (this is the important bit)
-------------------------------------------------------

Your work is NOT stored in this folder. It is stored in your own Windows
user data area:

       %APPDATA%\DigitalProductFactory\

Everything you make lives there: your ideas, products, sales, clients,
generated files, your settings, your AI key and your licence.

That is deliberate. It is why updating is safe, and why deleting this
program folder would NOT delete your products. It also means you never
have to move your data around by hand.


3. ADD YOUR AI KEY (needed before it can generate anything)
-----------------------------------------------------------

Open Settings (the gear icon) and paste ONE key from any of these:

       OpenAI      Anthropic      Google      DeepSeek      Moonshot

You bring your own key. The app does not include one and does not supply
one - you pay your chosen provider directly, at their prices.

The app tells you where to get a key for each provider, with a link.


4. IF YOU HAVE A LICENCE KEY
----------------------------

Click the key button at the bottom of the left sidebar and paste it in.

You only do this once. The app remembers it.


5. HOW TO UPDATE TO A NEW VERSION
---------------------------------

There is no automatic update. Updating is a download and a copy, and you do
NOT need to uninstall, and you do NOT need to delete anything.

   1. Download the new zip from the same address you used before.
   2. Right-click it and choose "Extract All".
   3. Extract it to the SAME folder you already have (the one with
      dpf.exe in it), and say YES when Windows asks to replace the files.
      (Windows may say "merge" - that is fine, choose it.)
   4. Start dpf.exe as usual.

That is the entire update.

If you would rather not overwrite: extract the new zip somewhere else and
copy ONLY the new  dpf.exe  over the old one. Same result.

You DO NOT need to:
   - re-enter your licence key
   - re-enter your AI key
   - re-import or move your products
   - delete the old folder first

Extracting to a brand new folder also works - your data is not in the
program folder, so it is picked up from %APPDATA% either way. You would
just have two copies of the program, and you can delete the older one
whenever you are happy with the new one.

DO NOT delete your folder as a way of updating. It is not needed, and if
you ever ran an older version that kept its data in the program folder,
deleting would take that with it.


6. CAN I DELETE THE OLD FOLDER?
-------------------------------

You do not have to. Extracting the new zip over your existing folder
replaces the program files (answer YES to Replace, or MERGE) and leaves
your data completely alone.

If you would rather start with a clean folder, this order is safe:

   1. Extract the new zip into a NEW folder.
   2. Run dpf.exe from the new folder.
   3. Check your products and your licence are there. They will be.
   4. Only then delete the old folder.

Deleting the old folder BEFORE updating is allowed, but check it first:
look inside it for a file called  dpf_data.db

   - No such file  ->  safe to delete. Your data is in %APPDATA%.
   - There IS such a file  ->  that is an older-format database. Run the
     app once from that folder BEFORE deleting, so it is imported into
     your Windows user data. The app never deletes that original file,
     so delete the folder yourself only after that import has happened.

The only other thing you lose by deleting a folder is dpf-startup.log,
which is just the previous run's diagnostic log. Nothing important.


7. IF WINDOWS SHOWS A WARNING
-----------------------------

When you first run it, Windows may say "Windows protected your PC".

That is SmartScreen: it says this about any new program that has not yet
built up a reputation, because it is not signed with an expensive
code-signing certificate. It is a warning, not a detection.

Click "More info", then "Run anyway". It only asks once.


8. IF THE WINDOW IS BLACK
-------------------------

A small number of graphics drivers draw this app as a blank window on one of
the two drawing methods it can use. It is a driver quirk, not a fault in your
copy.

The app normally sorts this out on its own: if the first drawing method fails
to start, it relaunches itself once using the other one. A window that is
black for a few seconds and then appears is that recovery working.

If it stays black, start it with the other method yourself - one double-click:

    dpf-glow.bat    run with OpenGL   (try this first on a VPS or Windows Server)
    dpf-wgpu.bat    run with DirectX  (the default)

Either way, dpf.exe writes a file called dpf-startup.log into this same
folder. It records which method was tried, which start-up step it reached,
and whether the first frame ever painted. If you need support, send that
file - it is the single most useful thing you can provide.


9. WHERE TO LEARN THE APP
-------------------------

   GUIDE.md                 the full user guide - setup and every screen
   MODULE-TEST-SHEET.md     a short sheet for checking every screen
   The "Guide" button       inside the app, bottom of the left sidebar

The in-app Guide covers every feature and opens from any screen.


FILES IN THIS FOLDER
--------------------

    dpf.exe                 the application
    dpf-glow.bat            start it with OpenGL     (use if dpf.exe is black)
    dpf-wgpu.bat            start it with DirectX    (the default)
    feature_tiers.json      which features each plan unlocks, and the upgrade link
    favicon/                the DPF brand icon set, for your own site or listing
    GUIDE.md                the full user guide
    MODULE-TEST-SHEET.md    a short sheet for checking every screen
    START-HERE.txt          this file
    dpf-startup.log         created after you run it - send this if you need help
